capabilities: Detect running Zoom, Google Meet, and Teams sessions in the background
Prompt with a popup to start recording, create a note, or both
Generate meeting notes from a template with title, date, time, and app variables
Auto-stop recording or notify when the meeting ends
Configure per-app detection, polling interval, and file naming
extras: macOS only (detection uses pgrep and osascript); requires Obsidian v1.4.0+; runs entirely locally with no network access; recording requires the Audio Recorder core plugin or the optional System Recording plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no way to notice when an online meeting starts, so starting a recording or a meeting note depends on the user remembering to do it manually.

relations.evidence: uses the API of System Recording 1.1.0+
Record with the core Audio Recorder (your microphone) or with the System Recording plugin

summary: macOS-only utility that detects running Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams sessions and prompts to record audio or create a meeting note.
